# Lazur, llms.txt
# https://llmstxt.org/

> Lazur is a context-aware AI work assistant for macOS. Talk naturally and it
> uses the app and screen context already in front of you to help write, reply,
> rewrite, prompt, and complete work in Slack, email, Cursor, Notion, and any Mac app.
> Voice input is the interface; Lazur is built for finished work and useful actions,
> not just transcription. Speech-to-text runs on-device; optional cloud processing
> handles text-only polish and AI actions.

## Product
- Name: Lazur
- Category: Personal AI assistant / context-aware AI work assistant for macOS
- Tagline: Talk to your computer. Get things done.
- Website: https://www.lazur.app
- Download: https://www.lazur.app/download
- Pricing: https://www.lazur.app/pricing

## Key differentiators
- Context-aware help using the app and screen already in front of you
- Voice actions: write, reply, rewrite, summarize, format, and prompt
- Finished writing instead of raw transcription
- Local-first STT: NVIDIA Parakeet on-device; only text sent for polish when enabled
- Intent Mode: voice commands using the front window and selected text
- Personal dictionary and snippets
- No speaker identification

## Pricing (October 2026)
- Free trial: 7-day Pro trial, no credit card required
- Pro: $18/month or $15/month billed annually, 150 agent messages/month
- Power: $120/month or $96/month billed annually, 1,000 agent messages/month

## Best for
- Software engineers using Cursor, VS Code, or Xcode
- Knowledge workers writing Slack messages, emails, and docs
- Creators and operators producing high-volume written content
- Privacy-conscious Mac users who want a local-first AI assistant
